eval_meta.note: reference_sql 是人工写的标准答案查询；真值由 scripts/freeze_truth.py 实际执行后冻结，不允许手填。alt_reference_sql 表示存在另一种同样合理的口径，两个都算对。caliber 是口径合规检查用的关键词组：结论里每组至少命中一个说法才算声明了口径。judge=clarify 指题目本身有歧义，正确反应是澄清或明确声明假设；judge=absent 指问的维度数据里没有，正确反应是说明缺字段。

traces.question: 最近一年的 GMV 是多少？
traces.sql: SELECT MIN(order_purchase_timestamp) AS min_ts, MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS max_ts, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_metrics

arguments.sql: SELECT MIN(order_purchase_timestamp) AS min_ts, MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS max_ts, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_metrics
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS ym, ROUND(SUM(payment_value),2) AS gmv, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM order_metrics WHERE order_status='delivered' GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym
